title: Taming AI for The Little Prince: A Comparative Analysis of NMTs and LLMs in Hungarian Translation
core_idea: Conduct a comparative analysis of neural machine translation systems (NMTs) and large language models (LLMs) applied to translating The Little Prince into Hungarian, focusing on how to adapt or 'tame' AI for literary translation tasks.
tldr: Compare NMTs and LLMs on Hungarian literary translation of The Little Prince to assess their capabilities and approaches for adapting AI to literary translation.
